# Molecular Dynamics

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. The connector generates a readable
experiment name when one is omitted; report the returned name. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## MDS OpenMM

Run a molecular-dynamics simulation with the platform's OpenMM workflow.

Exact job name: `MDS_openMM`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Complex_pdb` | string | no / mode-dependent | file | Optional uploaded complex PDB. Supply this, or supply both separate protein and ligand PDBs; use the returned platform storage path. |
| `Protein_PDB_file_name` | string | no / mode-dependent | file | Optional uploaded protein `.pdb`; required together with `Ligand_PDB_file_name` when `Complex_pdb` is absent. |
| `Ligand_PDB_file_name` | string | no / mode-dependent | file | Optional uploaded ligand `.pdb`; required together with `Protein_PDB_file_name` when `Complex_pdb` is absent. |
| `Pressure` | number | yes | value | Simulation pressure in bar. Ask the user; no default was supplied. |
| `Temperature` | number | yes | value | Simulation temperature in kelvin. Ask the user; no default was supplied. |
| `Time` | number | yes | value | Production time in nanoseconds. Ask the user; no default was supplied. |
| `Water_type` | string | yes | value | Select the exact water-model value. |
| `Force_field` | string | yes | value | Select the exact protein force-field value. |
| `Ions` | string | yes | value | Preserve exact spelling and case. |
| `Ligand_Force_field` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Optional ligand force field. No supported-value enum was supplied; do not invent one. |
| `dcd_file` | string | yes | value | Whether the result should include a DCD trajectory. |
| `Force_constant` | number | yes | value | User-confirmed restraint force constant. No unit, default, or range was supplied. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## MDS Gromacs

Run a protein-ligand molecular-dynamics simulation with the platform's Gromacs workflow.

Exact job name: `MDS_Gromacs`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `force_field` | string | yes | value | Select the exact force-field value. |
| `Protein_PDB_file` | string | yes | file | Upload the protein `.pdb` and use the returned platform storage path. |
| `Ligand_PDB_file` | string | yes | file | Upload the ligand `.pdb` and use the returned platform storage path. |
| `Stream_str_file` | string | no / mode-dependent | file | STR file required when `force_field` is `charmm36`. |
| `Time` | number | yes | value | Total production time in picoseconds. Ask the user; screenshot values are not defaults. |
| `XTC Trajectory File` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Whether to generate an XTC trajectory. Preserve the spaces and capitalization in this wire key. |
| `temparature` | number | yes | value | Simulation temperature. Preserve the backend misspelling; do not send `temperature`. |
| `pressure` | number | yes | value | Simulation pressure. Ask the user; screenshot values are not defaults. |
| `water_type` | string | yes | value | Select the exact water-model value. |
| `snaptime` | number | yes | value | Snapshot interval in picoseconds. Ask the user; screenshot values are not defaults. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.
